paragraphs: Yatsas. Batrim bar Yatsas; see his entry.[^1]

notes.text: Yatsas (יטסס) and Batrim (בטרים) are tentative readings and vocalizations; an earlier heading audit had יסכס. The pointer does not settle whether Batrim is a personal-name component or a bathhouse term, a question carried in the earlier editorial notes.
